fields.label: Core problem
fields.value: Provide abstractions that let software execute as though it has a dedicated computer or portable execution environment while sharing physical computing resources.

fields.label: Central model
fields.value: Physical hardware -> virtualization layer -> isolated system VM/guest OS OR host OS -> process VM -> portable program.

fields.value: Virtual machines are not one single mechanism.
